Rishabh Pant Out of India A Tour, Kumar Kushagra Replaces Him

Wicketkeeper-batsman Rishabh Pant has been ruled out of the first two matches of the India A team against New Zealand A due to injury. He has been replaced by young wicketkeeper-batsman Kumar Kushagra. The Board of Control for Cricket in India (BCCI) announced the replacement.
